Quezon City Flooding Event

Flooding Event in Quezon City (August 30, 2025)

● A severe thunderstorm affected the northern portions of Metro Manila on August 30, 2025, between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM.
● The Science Garden Station recorded 134.2 mm of rainfall, which is nearly equivalent to one week’s worth of rain based on the monthly normal of 568.5 mm.
● This heavy downpour caused significant flooding in several areas of Quezon City.
